policy: These are study targets or unresolved commissioning values, never a runnable hardware configuration. No entry is hardware-qualified. Resolve relevant entries and attach evidence before enabling a capability.

parameters.acceptance: Measure worst-case trajectory evaluation plus interrupts/IO/blocking and prove the approved deadline/headroom on the actual target.
Validate convergence corpus, maximum atomic step, total elapsed deadlines and memory under concurrent stepping/IO. Revise target based on evidence.
Qualify actual frame protocol, arbitration, physical layer, command skew and feedback age; no nominal/data bitrate is pre-approved.

parameters.unit: separate m, rad and derivative tolerances
parameters.acceptance: Derive numeric tolerances from conditioning, quantization, task needs and independent references; keep physical accuracy separate.
Qualify local-axis application skew in R1, then extend the budget through clock uncertainty and remote-drive timing in R3; bound resulting path error for each profile.
Budget production delay, detection, stop generation and execution horizon so stopping starts before usable data expires.
Derive lease timeout from qualified stop envelope, host latency and failure response; no arbitrary universal timeout.

parameters.unit: time, joint/TCP envelope and support conditions
parameters.acceptance: Measure detection-to-rest/support behavior under gravity, payload, lost actuation and power faults for each configuration.
Establish component/material limits, sensor uncertainty, warning/derating/trip behavior and gravity-support margin.
Qualify sampling, age, wrap ambiguity, noise and following-error thresholds per sensor and mode.

parameters.unit: bytes, outstanding frames and parser budget
parameters.acceptance: Choose bounded frame/queue/parser limits from actual commands, memory and worst-case traffic; fuzz limits and overflow paths.
Qualify controller/host/drive epoch mapping, clock error, drift and permitted scheduling horizon.

parameters.unit: cycles, failures, interventions and operating envelope
parameters.acceptance: Define product/task reliability objective, test population and stopping rules before endurance testing; report every intervention and failure.
